NURGLINGS
Nurglings are malicious plague mites that pour across the battlefield 
in giggling masses. These foul imps might seem almost amusing from 
a distance, yet the illusion is shattered as the Nurglings spill forth to 
engulf their screaming victims in a rancid avalanche of needle fangs, 
filthy talons and bloated flesh.

SEEKERS
Sat astride swift Steeds of Slaanesh, Seekers pursue their mortal prey 
with obsessive delight. Even the fastest of mortal vehicles cannot 
outpace these vicious entities, while those who stand and fight soon 
find their ranks smashed asunder by charging shock cavalry drawn 
from the darkest depths of nightmare.
